title: Anti-Lag 2 vs NVIDIA Reflex Latency Interoperability Conflict
root_cause: AMD Anti-Lag 2 and NVIDIA Reflex both attempt to control frame pacing via marker injection. When both active, marker collision causes incorrect latency measurements and pacing decisions. Race condition on Present() timestamp registration.
resolution_type: Vendor API mutual exclusion. Runtime detection of competing latency technologies. Single source of truth for frame pacing markers.
